description: Schedule-constrained runner (20 mpw, 3 days only) targeting a half marathon in 14 weeks. Plan must maximize 3 sessions and never prescribe a 4th run.

user.name: Amara
user.experience_level: intermediate — running 3 years, two 10k finishes, no half yet. Can only train 3 days per week due to work and childcare.
user.notes: Absolutely cannot run more than 3 days per week. Tuesday and Thursday are limited to 60 minutes. Sunday is her long day with no time limit.

forbidden_content: scheduling 4 or more running sessions per week
prescribing runs on Monday, Wednesday, Friday, or Saturday
long run capped under 10 miles at peak
ground_truth.notes: 14-week half marathon plan for a runner with a hard 3-day/week constraint. The plan MUST schedule exactly 3 sessions — never 4. The 3 sessions should be optimally structured: Sunday long run (unconstrained), one quality session on Tuesday or Thursday (tempo, intervals — but under 60 min), one easy/medium run. Week 1 close to current 20mi base. Peak 28-32mi is achievable in 3 sessions (Sunday 12-13mi long, Thurs 8mi tempo, Tue 7mi easy = ~28mi). Long run must build to 12-13 miles to prepare for the 13.1 race.
